It’s not even a duck!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 26.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} __toc__ ==Description== '''P3NGU''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has a high amount of health and 30% [[Defense]], but it walks rather slowly. '''P3NGU''' has one ability, ''Beak Beam'', where it will attack a tower with a laser fired from its beak. This laser will attack the targeted tower, stunning it and any other nearby tower in its attack cone for 4 seconds while also dealing 20 damage to units per tick. This ability has a tick of 0.1 and a range of 15. ==Logbook Description== "''P3NGU is the latest addition to Nerd Duck's inventions. Powered by cutting-edge bird technology, Nerd Duck based it on a flightless bird concept; something that's completely impossible. After all, a creature that waddles and can't fly couldn't possibly exist, right?''" ==Appearance== '''P3NGU''' is a regular penguin turned into a mech, with the only parts of its body not being entirely covered with mechanical parts being its torso and wings. On its mechanical head, it had giant, neon red eyes, and on its torso, it has a neon red light. All of its mechanical parts are connected to its body with giant screws. '''P3NGU''' also has a large metal jetpack on its back. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] can be used to kill '''P3NGU'''. **As '''P3NGU''' can stun towers, stun immune towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are useful here, as they cannot be stunned by it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the DPS of these towers. *Defense reducing towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to reduce its defense. **Do note that, on certain waves, '''P3NGU''' is a [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immune]] enemy. This means freezing towers will be unable to reduce its defense. **As for most waves, '''P3NGU''' does not have any stalling immunities, some of these towers can be used to also stall them. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:P3NGUFireStart.ogg]] |When the '''P3NGU''' performs ''Beak Beam'' ability |- |[[File:P3NGUFireLoop.ogg]] |When the '''P3NGU''' performs ''Beak Beam'' ability |- |[[File:P3NGUFireStop.ogg]] |When the '''P3NGU''' performs ''Beak Beam'' ability |- |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseP3NGU.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckyD00M3Thumbnail.png|'''P3NGU''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI4.png|'''P3NGU''' on a promotional image.
